ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the document:  Aaron Industries Limited reported a strong FY2025-26 with its highest-ever turnover of ₹92.21 Crore (+17.99% YoY) and healthy net profits of ₹6.80 Crore, driven significantly by the Stainless Steel Division, while the Elevator segment's growth, though temporarily impacted by geopolitical factors, is showing recovery in Q1 FY27. The company expanded manufacturing with Unit-3, launched an innovative EVOQ360 Home Lift, and expects to maintain 18-20% operating margins by passing on raw material cost increases. No auditor qualifications were reported, but shareholders will vote on revisions to the Chairman and Whole-Time Director's remuneration, which constitutes a material compensation change.
